_about: A class's passive features as documents (rules/classfeatures.py), keyed by the slug of
the grant on the class table. Read live; nothing is stored on a sheet. Rules from the
Core Rulebook paladin, checked against d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/paladin
(fetched 2026-10-05). The auras' ally halves (+4 morale to allies within 10 feet) wait
for a reader of who stands within 10 feet of whom and are said in each `not_yet`.

divine-grace.name: Divine grace
divine-grace.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 2nd level, a paladin gains a bonus equal to her Charisma bonus (if any) on all Saving Throws."

aura-of-courage.name: Aura of courage
aura-of-courage.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 3rd level, a paladin is immune to fear (magical or otherwise). Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects."
not_yet: the allies' +4 morale bonus against fear within 10 feet

divine-health.name: Divine health
divine-health.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 3rd level, a paladin is immune to all diseases, including supernatural and magical diseases, including mummy rot."

aura-of-resolve.name: Aura of resolve
aura-of-resolve.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 8th level, a paladin is immune to charm spells and spell-like abilities. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against charm effects."
not_yet: the allies' +4 morale bonus against charm within 10 feet

aura-of-faith.name: Aura of faith
aura-of-faith.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 14th level, a paladin's weapons are treated as good-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction."
not_yet: "Any attack made against an enemy within 10 feet of her is treated as good-aligned" — allies' attacks

aura-of-righteousness.name: Aura of righteousness
aura-of-righteousness.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 17th level, a paladin gains DR 5/evil and immunity to compulsion spells and spell-like abilities. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against compulsion effects." The DR is the table's own "damage reduction 5/evil" row, read by `damage-reduction`.
not_yet: the allies' +4 morale bonus against compulsion within 10 feet

damage-reduction.name: Damage reduction
damage-reduction.source: CRB, Paladin, Aura of Righteousness: "At 17th level, a paladin gains DR 5/evil" — the table's "damage reduction 5/evil" rung.

holy-champion.name: Holy champion
holy-champion.source: CRB, Paladin: "At 20th level, a paladin becomes a conduit for the power of her god. Her DR increases to 10/evil." Best-only against the 5/evil: DR never adds up.
not_yet: smite evil's banishment of an evil outsider: smite is lane 4's ability document
